decisions.executionNote: Remain stationary and observe the demonstration order.
Wait; demonstrator is grasping the red car first.
Observe red car transfer without moving.
Wait; first demonstrated placement is red car.
Remain stationary; observe next selection after red car.
Wait; second selected object is the phone, after red car.
Observe phone placement second; remain stationary.
Continue observing; remembered sequence red car then phone.
Remain still; demonstrator approaches watch for third selection.
Wait; third selection now appears to be black camera, not watch. First two were red car and phone.
Observe third object: camera being carried. Keep arms stationary.
Stationary observation: red car, phone, then camera.
Wait for remaining demonstration; camera is third after car and phone.
Remain stationary while observing fourth selection; remembered car, phone, camera.
Wait; fourth selection is watch. Sequence so far car, phone, camera, watch.
Observe watch transfer fourth without moving.
Wait for watch release and final doll demonstration; order car, phone, camera, watch.
Stationary observation; watch is fourth, doll remains for fifth.
Observe fifth object, doll; wait until demonstrator finishes and returns.
Wait for final doll placement. Memorized order: red car, phone, camera, watch, doll.
Remain still until fifth object is released and the demonstration arm finishes.
All five demonstration objects appear in basket; wait for demonstrator to return to rest.
Demonstrator is at rest. Begin cautious right-arm approach to red car first, raising and pitching gripper downward.
Align right gripper downward over the red car, keeping the left arm at rest.
Lower toward the car with small alignment corrections; verify finger placement before closing.
Shift grasp from car nose toward its middle and align jaws with its width before closing.
Close around the car and perform a short lift to check retention visually.
Car appears retained; lift and bring it to a central staging position on the right side for a non-crossing handoff.
Set the car on the central staging area and release; next the left arm will carry it to the policy basket.
Retract the right arm clear and bring left arm toward the staged car with a downward grasp orientation.
Align left gripper over the central staged car while right arm stays well clear on its own side.
Replan with smaller motions after continuity rejection; lower and align left fingers with staged car, keeping clear of the camera.
Grasp staged car with left fingers, then lift toward the left workspace; inspect retention and avoid nearby camera.
Carry retained car leftward at safe height toward policy basket; keep right arm clear.
Move car over the policy basket center and begin lowering while holding closed.
Release the first object, red car, inside the policy basket and lift clear.
Car is in basket; approach the phone second with right gripper aligned across its width.
Lower carefully around phone for the second placement, with small lateral correction.
Center jaws laterally on phone, close, then test retention with a short lift.
Phone appears held; lift and move toward a clear central staging spot without crossing arms.
Set phone down at the central staging spot for left-arm pickup, keeping both arms on their own sides.
Retract right arm from staged phone and orient left gripper for pickup, preserving separation.
Approach staged phone from the left and correct yaw to align jaws across its narrow dimension.
Lower left gripper onto staged phone with small lateral centering adjustments.
Refine phone centering, close left gripper, and test with a short leftward lift.
Carry retained phone toward basket at clearance height and align its length with the basket.
Correct phone yaw and position it over the empty rear portion of the policy basket while maintaining clearance.
Lower the phone into the rear basket space, still holding closed until placement is verified.
Release phone second in basket and lift away; begin orienting left gripper for the central camera third.
Approach the camera from the left with downward fingers aligned to its narrow dimension.
Align with the camera at the center boundary, lowering gradually while preserving elbow-up continuity.
Refine camera grasp using a slight wrist tilt, close fingers, and test retention with a short lift.
Camera appears retained; lift and carry it left toward the basket as the third object.
Position camera above an empty front-left part of the policy basket, clear of the first two objects.
Lower and release camera as the third object inside the basket, away from the car and phone.
Camera is inside basket; lift clear and reorient left gripper toward watch, the fourth target.
Approach watch from the left with corrected downward gripper orientation; first three objects remain in basket.
Center the left gripper over the watch and lower slowly for the fourth pickup.
Close around watch and test retention with a slow lift leftward.
Carry the retained watch toward policy basket as the fourth object, maintaining clearance.
Lower and release watch fourth into the open basket space beside the phone and car.
Watch is released in basket. Lift left clear and approach the final doll with the right gripper.
Lower right gripper gradually toward the doll; inspect alignment before closing.
Close around the final doll and make a short test lift to verify retention.
Lift and carry the retained doll toward the central staging area without crossing the arms.
Doll was not retained; return open right gripper over its current position for a lower, more secure grasp.
Recenter on the doll torso and descend further than the missed grasp; inspect before closing.
Shift grasp from the broad head toward the doll torso, close at lower height, and test a short lift.
Lift the doll vertically and begin a slow transfer toward staging, checking that it follows the gripper.
Doll follows the gripper; move it slowly to the central staging position for the final left-arm transfer.
Gently set the doll on the central table and release for a left-arm pickup.
Withdraw the right arm from the staged doll and bring the left arm toward it, keeping separation.
Doll rolled right after release; use right arm to reposition it nearer the central boundary before left pickup.
Regrasp the doll around its narrower torso from the right, with a small test lift.
Lift the regrasped doll and reposition its body toward the central boundary with a small wrist tilt; left arm remains clear.
Set the doll down gently at the central boundary, lower before releasing to reduce rolling.
Withdraw open right gripper upward and rightward; approach the staged doll with left arm only after separation.
Approach the doll from the left boundary with a slight inward wrist tilt and torso-aligned jaws; right arm remains clear.
Refine the left grasp around the doll torso and close at a lower height while staying on the left side.
Test the left doll grasp with a slow vertical lift, then begin moving into the left workspace.
Doll follows the left gripper; carry it toward the policy basket at clearance height as the fifth object.
